metadata.description: Model  of the Mauritanian EEZ to 200m deep built to account for the trophic structure in and outside the Banc d'Arguin.
metadata.author: Sylvie Guenette and Beyah Meissa
metadata.reference: Guenette S.,Meissa B.,Gascuel D.(2014). Assessing the Contribution of Marine Protected Areas to the Trophic Functioning of Ecosystems: A Model for the Banc d’Arguin and the Mauritanian Shelf Plos One. pp 1-16
